+// MORE TIME FOR A RUNNING PROCESS (+1 min on its line). Keyed by callId and the snippet step it runs under, so the
+// line of one call gives that call's process the minute; the snippet's own line gives it to every process it has running.
+const TOOL_EXTEND_HOOKS = new Map();
+function registerToolExtendHook(callId, step, fn) {
+  if (!callId || typeof fn !== 'function') return () => {};
+  if (!TOOL_EXTEND_HOOKS.has(callId)) TOOL_EXTEND_HOOKS.set(callId, new Set());
+  const set = TOOL_EXTEND_HOOKS.get(callId), h = { step, fn };
+  set.add(h);
+  return () => { set.delete(h); if (!set.size) TOOL_EXTEND_HOOKS.delete(callId); };
+}
+/** Give the running processes of one call (or of one of its snippet steps) `ms` more. Returns what each now has. */
+export function extendToolCall(callId, step = null, ms = 60000) {
+  const set = TOOL_EXTEND_HOOKS.get(callId);
+  if (!set) return [];
+  const out = [];
+  for (const h of [...set]) {
+    if (step != null && h.step !== step) continue;
+    try { const r = h.fn(ms); if (r) out.push({ step: h.step, ...r }); } catch {}
+  }
+  return out;
+}
+const fmtLimit = (ms) => (ms % 60000 === 0 ? `${ms / 60000} min` : `${Math.round(ms / 1000)} s`);

+  const fmtLimitMin = (ms) => (ms % 60000 === 0 ? (ms / 60000) + ' min' : fmtClock(ms));
+  // +1 MIN: the button on a running line. where() → { callId, step? } - a step's line gives that call's process the
+  // minute, a snippet's own line every process it has running. The new limits come back as the process's progress event.
+  function runMoreButton(where) {
+    const b = document.createElement('button');
+    b.type = 'button'; b.className = 'run-more'; b.textContent = '+1 min'; b.hidden = true;
+    b.addEventListener('click', async (e) => {
+      e.stopPropagation();
+      try {
+        const r = await fetch('/api/tool-more-time', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: JSON.stringify(where()) });
+        const j = await r.json().catch(() => ({}));
+        if (j && j.note) showToast(j.note);
+      } catch (err) { showError('Could not give it more time', err); }
+    });
+    return b;
+  }
+  // shown once the line shows its time, and only where a process has said how long it may run
+  function paintRunMore(row) {

+    const has = st ? (st.limitMs > 0 || st.quietMs > 0) : _callProcs.has(key);
+    b.hidden = row.dataset.cancelPending ? true : !(has && runTiming(row));
+  }

=== add test/test-proc-two-limits.mjs
new 31fdedc84447a8dcf97009e2
+/**
+ * A PROCESS CALL HAS TWO LIMITS (the developer, 2026-11-06: "1 for how long to wait when there's no output from the tool
+ * and 1 (much higher) for total time to catch loops"), and the developer can give a running one more time (+1 min).
+ *   [A] the defaults: 30 min in all, 5 min quiet - said to the screen when the process starts
+ *   [B] a process that prints nothing for its quiet limit is stopped, and the error says it was the quiet limit and what to do
+ *   [C] a process that keeps printing runs past its quiet limit; <js quiet_ms="0"> turns the quiet limit off
+ *   [D] more time while it runs: the limit that would stop it first gets it, the call ends normally, and its result says
+ *       the developer raised it; nothing running → nothing raised
+ *   [E] the snippet's own budget grows with it, so the snippet does not stop the process the developer let run on
+ *
+ * Run: node test/test-proc-two-limits.mjs
+ */
+import { mkdtemp, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
+import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
+import path from 'node:path';
+
+process.env.CB_JS_EVAL_BUDGET_MS = '6000';   // [E]: a snippet's budget, small enough to watch it grow (read when js-eval loads)
+const HOME = await mkdtemp(path.join(tmpdir(), 'cb-twolimits-home-'));
+process.env.CB_HOME = HOME;
+const { execute, extractContent, extendToolCall } = await import('../src/agent/tools.mjs');
+
+let pass = 0, fail = 0;
+const ok = (c, l) => { if (c) { pass++; console.log('  ok', l); } else { fail++; console.log('  FAIL', l); } };
+const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
+
+const proj = await mkdtemp(path.join(tmpdir(), 'cb-twolimits-'));
+// quiet for N ms, then one line
+await writeFile(path.join(proj, 'quiet.js'), 'setTimeout(() => console.log("finished fine"), Number(process.argv[2]));');
+// a line every 300 ms for N ms
+await writeFile(path.join(proj, 'chatty.js'), 'const end = Date.now() + Number(process.argv[2]); const t = setInterval(() => { console.log("still going"); if (Date.now() > end) { clearInterval(t); console.log("done"); } }, 300);');
+const run = async (code, extra = {}, args = {}) => String(extractContent(await execute('js_eval', { code, ...args }, {}, { cwd: proj, projectDir: proj, ...extra })));
+
+try {
+  console.log('\n[A] the defaults');
+  const said = [];
+  await run('return (await node(["quiet.js", "10"])).stdout;', { onProgress: (c, m) => { if (m && m.proc) said.push(m.proc); } });
+  ok(said.length === 1 && said[0].limitMs === 1800000 && said[0].quietMs === 300000 && said[0].pid > 0, `30 min in all, 5 min quiet, told when it starts (${JSON.stringify(said)})`);
+
+  console.log('\n[B] the quiet limit');
+  const t0 = Date.now();
+  const b = await run('return (await node(["quiet.js", "4000"], { quietMs: 1200 })).stdout;');
+  ok(Date.now() - t0 < 3500 && /KILLED: it printed nothing for its quiet limit/.test(b) && /\[stopped: no output\] killed after 1 s with no output/.test(b), `stopped at its quiet limit, and said so (${Math.round((Date.now() - t0) / 100) / 10} s: ${b.slice(0, 160).replace(/\n/g, ' | ')})`);
+  ok(/do not silence it, or give it \{quietMs\}/.test(b), 'and says what to do about it');
+
+  console.log('\n[C] output keeps it alive; quiet_ms="0" turns it off');
+  const c1 = await run('return (await node(["chatty.js", "2500"], { quietMs: 1000 })).stdout.split("\\n").filter(Boolean).pop();');
+  ok(/done/.test(c1), `a process printing every 0.3 s runs 2.5 s past a 1 s quiet limit (${c1.slice(0, 80)})`);
+  const c2 = await run('return (await node(["quiet.js", "1500"])).stdout;', {}, { quiet_ms: 0 });
+  const c2b = await run('return (await node(["quiet.js", "1500"])).stdout;', {}, { quiet_ms: 500 });
+  ok(/finished fine/.test(c2) && /printed nothing/.test(c2b), `quiet_ms="0": no quiet limit; quiet_ms="500": stopped (${c2.slice(0, 40)} | ${c2b.slice(0, 60)})`);
+
+  console.log('\n[D] more time while it runs');
+  const raised = [];
+  const pD = run('const r = await node(["quiet.js", "2500"], { quietMs: 1500 }); return JSON.stringify({ out: r.stdout.trim(), more: r.raisedByDeveloper || "" });', { callId: 'call-d', onProgress: (c, m) => { if (m && m.proc) raised.push(m.proc); } });
+  await sleep(700);
+  const got = extendToolCall('call-d', null, 2000);
+  const d = await pD;
+  ok(got.length === 1 && got[0].which === 'quiet' && got[0].quietMs === 3500, `the quiet limit, the one that would stop it first, got the time (${JSON.stringify(got)})`);
+  ok(/"out":"finished fine"/.test(d) && /The developer gave this call 1 more minute/.test(d), `it ran to its end, and its result says the developer raised it (${d.slice(0, 160)})`);
+  ok(raised.length === 2 && raised[1].quietMs === 3500 && raised[1].pid === raised[0].pid, 'the screen was told the new limit, for the same process');
+  ok(extendToolCall('call-d', null, 60000).length === 0 && extendToolCall('nobody', 3, 60000).length === 0, 'nothing running: nothing raised');
+
+  console.log('\n[E] the snippet\'s budget grows with it');
+  const t1 = Date.now();
+  const pE = run('return (await node(["chatty.js", "7500"])).stdout.split("\\n").filter(Boolean).pop();', { callId: 'call-e' });
+  await sleep(1000);
+  const gotE = extendToolCall('call-e', null, 4000);
+  const e = await pE;
+  ok(gotE.length === 1 && /done/.test(e), `a process given 4 s more runs 7.5 s inside a 6 s snippet budget (${Math.round((Date.now() - t1) / 100) / 10} s: ${e.slice(0, 120)})`);
+  const pE2 = run('return (await node(["chatty.js", "7500"])).stdout;', { callId: 'call-e2' });
+  const e2 = await pE2;
+  ok(/time budget/.test(e2), `without it the snippet's budget stops it (${e2.slice(0, 90)})`);
+} catch (e) { fail++; console.log('  FAIL harness:', e?.stack || e); }
+console.log(`\n${pass} passed, ${fail} failed`);
+process.exit(fail ? 1 : 0);
